cases.name: Lissette Garza Reinbold
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was baptized into the Catholic faith in Los Angeles, CA. She attended Highland Elementary School and Crookston High Schools in Crookston, MN. Her first job was at McDonalds and later worked at Villa St. Vincent in Crookston. She learned to work hard at an early age and loved the outdoors. She enjoyed fishing and snowmobiling with her Dad. Lissette is the very proud mother of Jared, Justin, Brielle and Kreedyn! After moving to rural Oklee in 2010, Lissette enjoyed being home with her children. She worked on home crafts and loved her life on the farm. Lissette was a friendly, social, very kind and caring person. She was a wonderful mother, daughter, sister and friend and will be dearly missed by all who knew her. She loved her pet dogs and cats and also loved butterflies. Lissette was a very active, loving mother to her kids. She was a dance mom, soccer mom, basketball mom, theater mom, softball mom, and swimming mom. She worked for a time as a barista at the Wired Bean in Thief River Falls. Lissette worked as a Customer Service Associate and Registration Specialist at Altru Clinic in Grand Forks and Thief River Falls and in June 2021 began work as an Insurance Representative at Sanford Health in Thief River Falls."
cases.narrative: He stabbed her 27 times in the neck, torso and upper extremities.
